title: An orthonormal n-frame in ℝⁿ has simple n-vector ±e₁∧⋯∧eₙ
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, ℝⁿ := Eucl n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), and e = (e_1,…,e_n) with e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1 the standard basis. If τ = (τ_1,…,τ_n) : Fin n → ℝⁿ is an orthonormal family, then simpleNVector τ = simpleNVector e or simpleNVector τ = −simpleNVector e. Here simpleNVector v is the n-vector α ↦ α(v) on n-covectors α, so the claim is τ_1∧⋯∧τ_n = ±e_1∧⋯∧e_n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (τ : Fin n → Eucl n), Orthonormal ℝ τ → simpleNVector τ = simpleNVector (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∨ simpleNVector τ = -simpleNVector (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))
